title: Chapter 177: Attacking The Demon Clan Castle
content:
Chapter 177: Attacking The Demon Clan Castle

Wu Qing satisfied Naga's curiosity about the transport host and briefly introduced the transport host to her.

But he did not elaborate on the details, nor did he invite Naga to board the transport host for a visit. Some things were not suitable for doing until they were close enough.

Naga's curiosity was satisfied a little, and then she gave up and started discussing other topics.

"The demons received a lot of reinforcements some time ago, and with the cooperation of the bear goblins, the offensive is very fierce!"

"The main combat forces of our tribe have been sent to the front line, and the situation has fallen into a stalemate!"

"This time they launched a battle to break the situation, I can only deal with it myself. I didn't expect that Nagalong would bring in the nobles as a strong ally and solve the dilemma of our tribe!"

"Now the forces used by the evil god camp to break the situation have been eliminated by us. The situation has reversed, and it's our turn to break the situation!"

"I'm not going to make a small fight. We will go to the most important gathering place of the demons' forces and join our army there, and strive to take down this hardest bone in one fell swoop!"

"As long as we take this place, the situation on the front line will change completely, and our tribe can launch a counterattack against the evil god camp together with the nobles!"

"No. 3, what do you think?"

Naga took out a map and placed it in front of host No. 3, and told host No. 3 her ideas.

Her strategic thinking is very consistent with her personality. She disdains to do such things as using the current superior forces to make a small fight.

If she wants to fight, she will fight the hardest battle, and strive to win the final victory in one battle and completely turn the tables!

Wu Qing also heard what Naga said. If this battle is to be fought, the main force must be the Naga army. The role of the Zerg army is very important, but it is no longer the only protagonist.

But it doesn't matter. As long as there is a battle, the Zerg will be willing to fight.

"Of course, no problem, our tribe will fully cooperate!"

Wu Qing agreed readily through host No. 3.

The two sides discussed some things again, and Naga left with Nagalong and her tribe.

The second batch of Zerg reinforcements arrived and joined the more than 60,000 surviving reinforcements of the first batch. The number of Zerg puppies exceeded 300,000, and the number of explosive mosquitoes also returned to 1,000.

Considering the upcoming war, the Naga tribe generously provided a large number of luck beads. Wu Qing chose ten explosive mosquitoes and upgraded them to three stars on the spot among the Zerg puppies.

The three-star explosive mosquitoes are several times larger in size, and the power of self-detonation is incomparable. Wu Qing has never been willing to use the only three-star explosive mosquito of the Zerg. Their true power can only be known after trying.

The Zerg reinforcements do not have long-range attack arms. With these ten three-star explosive mosquitoes, they can be regarded as having a big killer in hand, and they will be more confident in participating in such a war.

The Naga tribe is not stingy, and the Zerg tribe should be more generous, so that there will be more gains and everyone will be happy.

The Zerg transport host took the gene samples of the three arms of the demon tribe prepared by the host No. 3, and flew to the Zerg territory alone. When it left the sight of the Naga tribe, it turned on the stealth talent, so that the surrounding creatures unconsciously ignored it.

With this talent, the host will generally not be attacked. If it really encounters danger, the ability of the three-star host is enough to deal with it.

The flying speed of the three-star host is much faster than that of the Zerg puppy. It won’t take much time for the transport host to return to the Zerg territory.

The Zerg army quickly organized its formation and was ready to set off.

Without the burden of logistics, the Zerg army was extremely efficient.

The main force of the Naga tribe was also very fast. Their destination this time was a large front-line gathering place of the Naga tribe. They did not need to prepare too many things. Not long after, they set out under the leadership of Naga.

More than 150,000 Naga warriors were in front, more than 300,000 Zerg troops were behind, and nearly 500,000 elite troops marched rapidly towards the Naga front line.

Along the way, the Naga territory cities could be seen sporadically, proving that this area was still under the control of the Naga tribe.

The terrain of the Naga tribe's sphere of influence was very flat. They walked in a straight line all the way. After about an hour of rapid march, a huge city appeared in front.

Wu Qing possessed the No. 3 host and looked far away in the air. He could roughly see the scale of the city in front, which was slightly larger than Guangfu City.

It can be seen that the city is full of Naga troops stationed, and various large-scale combat equipment that Wu Qing has never seen can be vaguely seen.

Host No. 3 flew upwards again, and could already see a large castle that looked very similar to a Western castle not far away from the opposite side of the Naga city.

When the army entered the range of the Naga city, a team of Naga warriors rushed over to welcome Naga's arrival.

"Elder!"

A Naga female general who looked very similar to Naga came to Naga's side.

Except for the lighter gold color of her armor and snake tail scales than Naga, she was exactly the same as Naga, and even looked similar.

"Naga Sa, what's the situation here?"

Naga did not stop, but asked the Naga female general who came to greet her while walking.

The main force of the Naga tribe and the Zerg army continued to march towards the city. The gate of the city in front was opened, ready to welcome the army into the city.

"Replying to the elder, in the past few days, the demons have launched several tentative attacks, but we repelled them all!"

"There have been sporadic demon troops gathering at the Demon Castle opposite. I estimate that the war will begin soon!"

"I am fully prepared here and can guarantee that I can survive three rounds of large-scale attacks!"

The female general of the Naga tribe named Naga Sa did not know the purpose of Naga's coming this time, but she thought that as an elder, Naga would not personally lead troops to help her defend the city.

"How many troops are there in the Demon Castle opposite?"

Naga continued to ask.

"We estimate that the number of demon troops gathered in the Demon Castle should be close to one million!"

The Naga tribe is not a Zerg tribe. In terms of intelligence collection, they have no advantage against the ferocious demon tribe.

The number of enemy troops can only be roughly estimated, and it cannot be very accurate.

"Close to one million? You should have more than 700,000 troops here, plus the elite troops I brought, it's enough to fight!"

"Naga Sa! You don't have to follow me!"

"I order you! Immediately follow the battle plan of a full-scale attack on the Demon Castle! Be sure to launch a full-scale attack on the Demon Castle before noon!"

"We will be your vanguard now!"

Naga Yu only asked about the strength of the demon tribe, and then issued an order to Naga Sa to launch a full-scale attack on the Demon Castle.

"Yes! Elder!"

Naga Sa took the order without any hesitation, turned around and left, and immediately returned to the city to arrange combat tasks.

The attack must be launched before noon, and the mobilization of 700,000 troops is not a simple matter.

Fortunately, the army in her hands has a predetermined plan for this situation, and it can be executed step by step.

Naga Yu led the elite troops of the Naga tribe and the Zerg army, bypassed the city, and headed towards the Demon Castle that Wu Qing saw from afar in the sky.

Before long, the entire Naga city's army was mobilized, a large number of scouts were sent out, and the elite troops had begun to line up outside the city, waiting for the battle.

The large combat equipment that Wu Qing saw also began to be moved outside the city.

All the gates of the city were open, and it seemed very lively, but they were busy and orderly, very efficient, and it was obvious that a lot of preparations had been done in advance.

Now it was still a long time before noon. At this efficiency, Naga Sa could complete the task assigned by Naga Si.

Through a simple command, we can see the ability level of Naga Si, Naga Sa and the entire Naga tribe.

The superiors know the subordinates, and the orders they issue are reasonable; the generals know the soldiers, and all kinds of contingencies are fully prepared, so they can respond calmly when encountering emergencies; the soldiers are well-trained and busy but not chaotic.

Wu Qing saw the style of the native camp of this world from the Naga tribe. Only such a race can persist under the crazy attack of the evil god camp.

The Naga elite troops and the Zerg army were very fast. It didn't take long for them to bypass the Naga city. Not far ahead, they could reach the large demon castle of the demons.

The daytime combat time in this world is limited, and the distance between the garrisons of the two hostile parties is not too far, which is convenient for combat.

The Naga city and the demon castle are about ten miles apart, and the large plain between the two sides is a ready-made battlefield.

The cities in this world are built to be large, covering a wide area and deep, and with the surrounding agricultural areas, mineral areas and other resource areas, they can support a large population.

Ordinary intelligent races usually build cities.

The castle is built to a high place, generally not occupying a large area, and can accommodate a large population on limited land. It is very suitable for the front-line battlefield with sufficient supplies, easy to defend and difficult to attack.

The castle is also suitable for races like the demons who absorb fire elements to survive and do not need too much logistical supplies.

The demon castle opposite the Naga city, although it used a lot of stone, still looked very simple, as if it was built in a hurry.

Naga led the army to the edge of the range of the long-range weapons of the demon castle, full of provocation!

Wu Qing observed closely and found that there were almost no defensive weapons on the tall walls of the demon castle. It can be seen that the demons have always been the active attackers, suppressing the Naga tribe in all aspects.

Faced with the provocation of the Naga army rushing to the city, the warlike demons were certainly not afraid. Immediately, a powerful flame demon rode a giant dog demon and led the demon army out of the castle to fight.

Seeing that the demons dared to come out to fight, the Naga tribe took the initiative to lead the army to retreat and give up the battlefield. It was a very stupid act to fight the enemy under the enemy's wall.

The demons should have also discovered the mobilization of the Naga city's army. The demon army in the demon castle was constantly being mobilized.

The battle between the two sides was about to break out!
